newsitem.title: USA: Network to acquire National Teleservice.
newsitem.headline: Network to acquire National Teleservice.

text.p: Network Long Distance Inc said Tuesday it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire National Teleservice Inc for about 3.275 million shares of its common stock.
The company said it will assume more than $1 million in cash and $600,000 in outstanding debt.
Based on March 1997 sales, National Teleservice has current annualized revenues of about $26.5 million, Network said.
National Teleservice, based in Winona, Minnesota, is a provider of voice and data services in the Midwest, it said.
The company said the acquisition helped it realize its goal of surpassing $100 million in annualized revenue.
Network Long Distance currently has 14.0 million average shares outstanding, it said.
